_meta.note: User-facing interface strings used by the app. Keys are stable; placeholders in braces are filled by the app.

returns.perishable.text: Refund if it arrives not right

hello.demo.text: Hi Maya. This is a simulation. I have ideas for you and I will always say why. I never buy anything without the rules you set. Try: What is my rule?

hello.fresh.text: Hi. This is a simulation. Nothing is turned on yet. Turn on ideas for a category in Rules and I will start there.

reason.restock.text: You bought {product} on {last}. You usually reorder about every {cycle} days, and it has been {days}.

reason.price_drop.text: You bought {product} on {last} at {old}. It is {new} now.

reason.reminder.text: On {note} you set a gift reminder for {event}. This is an idea for you, not a purchase.

why.card.text: You are seeing this because you turned on ideas for {cat} on {since}. Nudge uses just the things you did here: past orders, reminders you set, and prices of items you bought before. There are no timers and no stock counts. Dismiss it and Nudge will adjust.

learn.not_interested.text: Got it. I will not suggest {product} again.

learn.have_it.text: Got it. I will not suggest {product} for 30 days.

learn.too_soon.text: Got it. I will wait 7 days before suggesting {product} again.

learn.price.text: Got it. I will not suggest {product} again.

learn.fewer.text: You dismissed three {cat} ideas in a row, so I will show only one idea at a time now. You can turn ideas off in Rules.

reason.WITHIN_MANDATE.text: This was inside your limits, so no extra yes was needed.

reason.AMOUNT_OVER_PER_PAYMENT_LIMIT.text: Nudge may not buy this alone, so it needed your yes.

reason.DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.text: This went past your daily limit, so it needed your yes.

reason.PAYEE_NOT_ALLOWLISTED.text: This store is not on the list, so Nudge did not buy it.

reason.PURPOSE_NOT_PERMITTED.text: This category is not allowed, so Nudge did not buy it.

reason.MANDATE_EXPIRED.text: The rule had ended, so Nudge did not buy it.

reason.MANDATE_NOT_FOUND.text: There was no rule for this, so Nudge did not buy it.

reason.AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE.text: The amount was not valid, so Nudge did not buy it.

reason.CURRENCY_MISMATCH.text: The currency did not match, so Nudge did not buy it.

did_not.AMOUNT_OVER_PER_PAYMENT_LIMIT.text: I did not buy {item} on my own. It is above your {item_lim} limit per item. It is waiting for your yes.

did_not.DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.text: I did not buy {item} on my own. It would pass your {day_lim} daily limit. It is waiting for your yes.

did_not.PAYEE_NOT_ALLOWLISTED.text: I did not buy {item} on my own. {merchant} is not one of the stores you approved for this. It is waiting for your yes.

did_not.MANDATE_EXPIRED.text: I did not buy {item} on my own. Your rule for it has ended. It is waiting for your yes.

did_not.PURPOSE_NOT_PERMITTED.text: I did not buy {item} on my own. That category is not in your rule. It is waiting for your yes.

did_not.MANDATE_NOT_FOUND.text: I did not buy {item} on my own. There is no rule for it. It is waiting for your yes.

did_not.AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE.text: I did not buy {item}. The amount was not valid.

did_not.CURRENCY_MISMATCH.text: I did not buy {item}. The currency did not match.

did_not.PAUSED.text: I did not prepare {item}. {cat} is paused.

source.auto.text: Bought by Nudge inside your limits

mandate.suggest.text: Nudge may not buy {cat} items by itself. It shows ideas and you decide.

mandate.ask.text: Nudge may not buy {cat} items by itself. It prepares orders and asks for your yes each time.

mandate.limits.text: Nudge may buy {cat} items up to {item} each and {day} a day from {merchants}, until {until}. Anything else it asks you first, and anything at {cap} or more always needs a code on your phone.

mandate.paused.text: {cat} is paused. Nudge will not buy or prepare anything by itself.

confirm.tier.text: You want to give Nudge more room for {cat}: {tier}. Say yes to confirm.

confirm.tier_limits.text: That means up to {item} each and {day} a day from {merchants}.

confirm.limit.text: Raise the {which} for {cat} to {amount}? Say yes to confirm.

limit.clamped.text: The most Nudge can do alone is {cap} per item, because {step} or more always needs a code on your phone.

limit.stored.text: Saved limits of {item} each and {day} a day for {cat}. They apply only if you turn on Within limits.

log.pause.text: Paused {scope}. Nudge will not buy or prepare anything by itself.

offer.ask.text: You have approved three {cat} orders. Want me to prepare {cat} orders for you and ask each time? Say yes or tap below.

offer.limits.text: You have approved three {cat} orders. Want me to handle small ones? I would buy up to {item} each and {day} a day from {merchants}. Anything else I would still ask about. This rule would end on {until}. Say yes or tap below.

offer.accepted.text: Done. {cat} has moved up. You can pause or change it any time.

offer.declined.text: No problem. {cat} stays as it is. I will ask again after three more approvals.

log.offer_declined.text: You said not now to a step up for {cat}.

reset.note.text: I moved {cat} back to Ask first.

reset.why.undo.text: you undid an order I placed

log.reset.text: {cat} moved back to Ask first because {why}.

readback.one.text: Buying {item} from {merchant} for {amount}. It arrives {date}. Card ending {last4}.

readback.ask.text: Say yes to buy, or no.

stepup.why.text: This is {limit} or more, so I need an extra check.

stepup.why_total.text: The total is {limit} or more, so I need an extra check.

stepup.ask.text: I sent a 4 digit code to your phone. Type it here.

stepup.wrong.text: That code does not match. {left} tries left.

stepup.locked.text: Too many wrong codes. Nothing was bought. The orders are still waiting.

stepup.expired.text: That code ran out of time. Nothing was bought. The orders are still waiting.

log.stepup_locked.text: Three wrong codes. Nothing was bought.

phone.code.text: Your Nudge code is {code}. It approves {amount}. Do not share it.

done.one.text: Done. {item} is ordered. It arrives {date}. You can undo it for {hours} hours.

done.many.text: Done. {count} orders placed. You can undo them for {hours} hours.

done.unknown.text: I could not confirm that {item} went through. I will not charge you twice. Use Check with the store.

done.failed.text: {count} order did not go through. You were not charged.

session.declined.text: Okay. I did not buy it.

session.later.text: Okay. It stays on your list. Nothing was bought.

session.reask.text: I need a yes or a no first.

log.bought.text: Bought {item} from {merchant} for {amount}. You approved by {channel}.

log.auto_bought.text: Bought {item} from {merchant} for {amount} by myself, inside your limits.

log.prepared.text: Prepared {item} for {amount}. It is waiting for your yes.

log.unknown.text: I could not confirm {item}. It may or may not have gone through. I will check before I try again.

log.failed.text: {item} did not go through. You were not charged.

log.approval_error.text: I could not approve {item} ({code}). Nothing was bought.

log.nothing_due.text: Nothing is due right now. I will say why when something is.

log.expired.text: The request for {item} ran out of time. Nothing was bought.

log.advanced.text: The demo clock moved forward {hours} hours to {now}.

undo.done.text: Undone. {item} is cancelled and {amount} is refunded.

problem.thanks.text: Sorry about {item}. I have noted it on the receipt.

problem.already_asks.text: {cat} already asks before buying, so nothing changes there.

reconcile.found.text: The store did accept {item}. It is one order, charged once.

reconcile.unsure.text: The store did not give a clear answer about {item}, so the outcome is still unknown. Nothing will be retried until it can be checked.

reconcile.none.text: The store has no record of {item}. You were not charged.

retry.done.text: Tried again with the same request number. {item} went through once.

retry.still.text: Still not sure about {item}. Nothing was charged twice.

story.intro.text: On {when}, Nudge asked to buy {item} from {merchant} for {amount} ({cat}).

statushelp.PENDING_APPROVAL.text: Nothing was bought. It is waiting for your yes.

statushelp.SUCCEEDED.text: The simulated store accepted the order.

statushelp.FAILED.text: The store did not accept it. You were not charged.

statushelp.UNKNOWN.text: The store did not answer. It may or may not have gone through. You will not be charged twice.

statushelp.BLOCKED.text: A rule said no. Nothing was bought.

statushelp.DENIED.text: You said no. Nothing was bought.

statushelp.EXPIRED.text: No answer in time. Nothing was bought.

statushelp.CANCELLED.text: You undid it within the window. The simulated refund is done.

verify.broken.text: Receipt check failed. First broken record: {id} ({code}).

tamper.result.text: On a copy, one amount was edited. Verify names the first broken record: {id} ({code}). Your real receipts were not touched.

cmd.paused.text: Paused {scope}. I will not buy or prepare anything by myself.

cmd.limit_missing.text: Tell me the amount, for example: set groceries limit to 30 dollars.

cmd.no_rules.text: No category is turned on yet.

cmd.pending.text: {count} orders are waiting for your yes. Say approve my digest, or open Today.

cmd.nothing_to_confirm.text: There is nothing to confirm right now.

cmd.unknown.text: I did not catch that. You can say: what is my rule, pause groceries, set groceries limit to 30 dollars, approve my digest, or undo my last order.

err.STORAGE_ERROR.text: The simulated store could not save that, so it may or may not have gone through. Check Orders and receipts before you try again, then restart the demo.

err.RESTART_REQUIRED.text: A save failed earlier, so Nudge has stopped taking actions until it is restarted. Check Orders and receipts after the restart.

err.NEED_HISTORY.text: Approve a few {cat} orders first, so I know which stores you trust.

err.NO_OFFER.text: There is no offer to answer.

err.NOT_PENDING.text: That order is not waiting for a yes.

err.NO_CODE_PENDING.text: No code is being asked for.

err.NOT_FOUND.text: I could not find that order.

err.UNDO_NOT_AVAILABLE.text: There is no recent order to undo.

err.NO_PROBLEM_REPORT.text: A problem cannot be reported on this order.

err.NOT_UNKNOWN.text: That order does not need a check.

err.NOTHING_TO_TAMPER.text: There is no completed order to use for the demo.

err.BAD_JSON.text: That request could not be read.

ui.sim_banner.text: This is a simulated voice assistant. The purchase step is a mock. No real store, card, or phone is involved.

ui.mic_unavailable.text: Speech input is not available in this browser. Typing works the same way.

ui.mic_note.text: Speech input uses your browser's own speech service, which may send audio to its provider. It is off until you press Speak.

ui.tts_unavailable.text: Reading aloud is not available in this browser.

ui.phone_empty.text: No messages yet. A code arrives here when an order needs an extra check.

ui.today.ideas_empty.text: Nothing to suggest right now. An idea appears when there is a reason, and the reason is always shown.

ui.today.ideas_off.text: Ideas are off until you turn them on for a category in Rules.

ui.digest.hint.text: Small orders Nudge prepared. One yes covers all of them. Each still gets its own receipt.

ui.digest.stepup.text: The total is at or above the code limit, so a phone code will be asked for.

ui.today.needs.text: Needs your yes and a phone code

ui.today.feed.text: What Nudge did, and what it did not do

ui.run_hint.text: Simulates the assistant's scheduled check. What it does depends on your rules.

ui.card.sample.text: Sample product. The picture is illustrative.

ui.card.stepup.text: Needs a phone code at {limit} or more

ui.dismiss.title.text: Tell Nudge why. It will learn.

ui.shop.hint.text: Tap Review and buy. Nudge reads the order back and waits for your yes.

ui.rules.dial.text: How much may Nudge do for {cat}?

ui.tier.suggest.desc.text: Nudge shows ideas. You decide and buy.

ui.tier.ask.desc.text: Nudge prepares orders and asks for your yes each time.

ui.tier.limits.desc.text: Nudge buys small things by itself inside the limits below. Everything else it asks about.

ui.rules.progress.text: Approvals toward the next step: {n} of 3

ui.rules.limits_note.text: Within limits can never go above {cap} per item.

ui.rules.voice_hint.text: You can also say: Set groceries limit to 30 dollars.

ui.orders.verify_hint.text: Recomputes the whole receipt chain and names the first record that changed.

ui.error.render.text: The page could not draw your data. Details are in the browser console.

ui.error.start.text: Nudge could not start. Retry in a moment.

ui.code.no_session.text: There is no purchase waiting for a code. Choose something to buy first.

ui.demo.note.text: These controls exist for the demo and are not part of the shopper experience.

ui.fault.timeout_after_accept.text: Times out after the store accepted it

ui.fault.timeout_before_accept.text: Times out before the store got it

ui.demo.tamper.text: Show what tampering looks like (on a copy)

ui.demo.payments.text: Running total for this whole demo, all orders: {made} payments accepted by the mock store, {net} after refunds. Each order card shows its own charge count.

ui.footer.text: Independent prototype with sample products, sample prices and a mock payment step. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any retailer or voice assistant maker.

ui.stage.confirm.text: Waiting for your yes or no

err.NO_READBACK.text: There is no read-back open. Prepare an order first so I can read it back to you.

err.CODE_TOO_EARLY.text: No code has been asked for yet. Give your yes first.

ui.mcp_log.text: Tool calls this page made (Model Context Protocol)

ui.mcp_hint.text: Every purchase step above is a tool call to the local server at /mcp. This page is the client.

err.NOT_AUTHORIZED.text: Only a person using the Nudge page can do that. Nothing was changed.

err.NEED_APPROVALS.text: Nudge needs {need} approved {cat} orders before it can buy within limits. You have {have} so far.

err.DAY_BELOW_ITEM.text: The daily limit ({day}) cannot be lower than the per item limit ({item}). Nothing was saved.

err.DAY_TOO_HIGH.text: The daily limit can be at most {cap}. Nothing was saved.

err.NO_PROPOSAL.text: That change is not waiting for you any more. Nothing changed.

err.PROPOSAL_EXPIRED.text: That change ran out of time. Nothing changed. Ask again to see the current terms.

err.PROPOSAL_STALE.text: Things changed since that was shown, so I did not apply it. Ask again to see the current terms.

err.UNRESOLVED_ORDER.text: An earlier order for {item} ({order}) is not settled yet: {status}. Use Check with the store first, so you are not charged twice.

err.PROPOSAL_MISMATCH.text: That answer was for a different read-back, so nothing was bought. Ask again to hear the current one.

err.TERMS_CHANGED.text: The price or delivery changed since I read it back. Nothing was bought. Ask again to hear the new terms.

err.READBACK_EXPIRED.text: That read-back ran out of time. Nothing was bought. Ask again.

err.STEPUP_WRONG.text: That code does not match. {left} tries left. Nothing was bought.

err.STEPUP_LOCKED.text: Too many wrong codes. Nothing was bought. The orders are still waiting.

err.STEPUP_EXPIRED.text: That code ran out of time. Nothing was bought. The orders are still waiting.

err.CODE_REQUIRED.text: A phone code is needed first. It was sent to the simulated phone.

err.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.text: I could not confirm that the order went through. You will not be charged twice.

err.OUTCOME_FAILED.text: The order did not go through. You were not charged.

cmd.negated.text: I heard a no in that, so I did not do anything. If you want it, say it plainly, for example: resume groceries.

cmd.unsupported_period.text: I can only set a limit per item or per day, not per week or month.

proposal.limits.text: Switch {cat} to Within limits? I would buy up to {item} each and {day} a day from {merchants}, until {until}. Nothing changes until you confirm.

proposal.ask.text: Switch {cat} to Ask first? I would prepare orders and ask for your yes each time. Nothing changes until you confirm.

proposal.limit_change.text: Change the {cat} limits to {item} each and {day} a day? Nothing changes until you confirm.

proposal.waiting.text: Waiting for the person to confirm this in the Nudge page. Nothing has changed yet.

log.limits_set.text: {cat} limits are now {item} each and {day} a day.

did_not.UNRESOLVED.text: I did not prepare {item}. An earlier order for it is not settled yet. Use Check with the store first.

ui.mcp.retry.text: Could not reach the local tool server. Try again.

ui.mcp.reconnected.text: Reconnected to the local tool server.

ui.demo.restored.text: Restored from the saved receipts and state.
